text:
tessa: Quick heads-up — we need to cut release/v2.0 today (2.0.0-rc1). Target cutoff 18:00 PT. Can folks confirm who will own branch creation, who handles backports, and any special rules for docs vs behavior fixes?

amy: I can create the branch and do the initial smoke run. Planning to do the branch creation around 16:00 PT to leave room for fixes. :+1:

raj: For backport rules my proposal: docs-only = auto-approve as long as CI passes; bugfixes (non-behavioral) = single approver + CI green; behavior changes or API changes = explicit release lead sign-off (tessa) + passing e2e. Thoughts?

lin: +1 to raj. Also: if a backport touches vendor/ or submodules, prefer deferring to next release unless it's security.

samir: FYI there are two open PRs that might need cherry-picks: #4721 (session timeout fix) and #4749 (chore: deps bump). I'll add labels.

release-bot: branch created: release/v2.0 from origin/main by amy at 1963503000. CI pipeline queued.

amy: Command I used for branch creation in case folks want to replicate:```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/v2.0 origin/main
git push origin release/v2.0
```

tessa: Thanks amy. For cherry-picks, please use the canonical pattern and include the original commit reference. Example:```bash
git checkout release/v2.0
git cherry-pick -x <sha>  # include -x for traceability
# resolve conflicts if any
git push origin release/v2.0
```

raj: Small process nit: mark backport PRs with label `release/backport-needed` and add the target branch in the PR body. Makes triage easier.

lin: Who's owning the changelog updates? We should collect succinct lines for 2.0 RC1 and ensure contributors add entries. I can collate if people drop 1-line summaries in this thread.

samir: I'll drop short notes for the two PRs: `session: reduce idle timeout to 30m (bugfix)` and `deps: bump lib-crypto (chore)`

amy: CI is showing a flaky test on main (integration/kv/timeout) — I'm going to run the smoke suite locally. If it flakes, we should delay cut by 30m.

tessa: Agree. No branch freeze until smoke is green. If flaky persists, we'll cut and mark the test as flaky with a follow-up issue, but prefer to unblock fixes before RC.

raj: For cherry-picks that are non-trivial (conflicts expected), please post short note here like `cherry-pick: <sha> -> release/v2.0 (needs conflict resolve)` so we track ownership.

amy: Done. I picked #4721 into release/v2.0, had to fix small import path. Pushed at 1963503305.

release-bot: CI passed for release/v2.0 @ 1963503400 (unit + lint).

lin: Changelog draft (will paste to PR soon):
- auth: reduce session idle timeout to 30m (bugfix)
- infra: bump lib-crypto to 2.4.1 (chore)
- docs: clarify private deployment network guide (docs)

samir: Added `release/backport-needed` to #4749 (deps bump). It's deps-only so OK to auto-approve once CI passes.

tessa: Final checklist before cutoff:
- [x] branch created (amy)
- [x] smoke tests green (amy)
- [ ] changelog entries collated (lin)
- [ ] any remaining behavior changes signed off (tessa)
- [ ] backports merged and labeled (raj/samir)

raj: I'll do a final sweep at 17:30 PT for any outstanding backport PRs. Ping me if you need help resolving conflicts.

lin: I'll open the changelog PR at 17:40 PT.

tessa: If nobody objects, we'll treat deps-only and docs-only backports as safe to merge after CI. Anything that mutates public APIs or behavior needs my explicit go. Ping me directly for those.

amy: thumbs up. Preparing to tag RC after changelog PR lands. I'll post tagging command then.

samir: tagging note: use annotated tag `v2.0.0-rc1` and push:```bash
git tag -a v2.0.0-rc1 -m "v2.0.0-rc1"
git push origin v2.0.0-rc1
```

tessa: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will monitor and be available for sign-offs.

amy: Branch cut complete, changelog PR opened, tagging after merge.🎉
